data.description: Current: apply_writes() then log_tx_commit(). Must be: log_tx_commit() then fsync then apply_writes(). Core ACID violation.

properties.retrospective: Fixed WAL commit order - log TX_COMMIT before applying writes, fsync before modifying entities. This ensures WAL is source of truth and entities can be recovered.

data.title: Fix WAL commit order: log COMMIT before applying writes
